name: Toes to Bar
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar and hang with your arms straight and your body in a long line.
Press down slightly on the bar and lift your straight or slightly bent legs up until your toes touch the bar.
Lower your legs back down under control and let them swing slightly behind you.
Keep the swing small and controlled to protect your shoulders. Build up with hanging knee raises first.
image_prompt_scene: Hanging from a high pull-up bar by both hands with the arms fully extended, the feet well clear of the floor with a gap of about a foot below the toes, body straight.
